description: Optical materials shipped with the FullMeta ray-tracing module. 'Add material from library' copies an entry into the project. Formulas use the vacuum wavelength in µm; see js/materials.js.

materials.name: Air (n = 1, glass-catalogue convention)
materials.reference: Glass catalogue indices (SCHOTT) are relative to air, so lens design normally treats air as n = 1.

materials.name: Air, absolute (Ciddor 1996)
materials.reference: P. E. Ciddor, Appl. Opt. 35, 1566-1573 (1996): standard air, 15 °C, 101.325 kPa, 0% humidity, 450 ppm CO2. Absolute index: pair it only with absolute glass data.

materials.name: SCHOTT N-BK7
materials.reference: SCHOTT optical glass data sheet N-BK7 (nd = 1.51680, vd = 64.17). Relative to air.

materials.name: SCHOTT N-SF11
materials.reference: SCHOTT optical glass data sheet N-SF11 (nd = 1.78472, vd = 25.68). Relative to air.

materials.name: Fused silica (Malitson 1965)
materials.reference: I. H. Malitson, J. Opt. Soc. Am. 55, 1205-1209 (1965), 20 °C (nd = 1.4585). C = λi² from the published resonance wavelengths 0.0684043, 0.1162414, 9.896161 µm.

materials.name: Calcium fluoride (Malitson 1963)
materials.reference: I. H. Malitson, Appl. Opt. 2, 1103-1107 (1963), 24 °C (nd = 1.4338). C = λi² from the published resonance wavelengths 0.050263605, 0.1003909, 34.649040 µm.
